title: 第6章 开除不了的人，门当户对的两人
slug: 斗罗冬儿重生我不是唐舞桐
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

中午下课回来，霍雨浩把上午周漪讲课的内容都给王冬儿复述了一遍，担心她错过了重要的知识。

这些内容王冬儿当然都知道，但她并没有阻拦霍雨浩，津津有味的听他讲着。

“还有其他的吗，霍老师？”

霍雨浩被王冬儿一句霍老师叫得脸红了。

“上课讲的就这些。”

“对了，下课后周老师带我去了魂导器研究所，以后我要学习魂导器制作。”

“这样会不会太累啊。”

霍雨浩摇摇头：“不会的，我也想要多学习一点，变得更强。”

“加油，我觉得你以后一定能成为很强的魂师和魂导师。”王冬儿鼓励霍雨浩。

“真的吗？”

“当然，我相信你没问题的。”

得到王冬儿的信任，霍雨浩非常开心。

下午的时候，王冬儿没有和霍雨浩一起去上课。

但她还是来到上课的操场上，看着霍雨浩负重跑步。

上午跑了下午也跑，周漪是没有其他的可以教了吗？

王冬儿的目光一直落在霍雨浩身上。

看着那个小小的身体负重前行，她很是心疼。

他是那样的坚强，明明是魂力最弱的一个，却还坚持到最后。

其他已经放弃的学生，见到霍雨浩的锲而不舍，被打动了，跟在霍雨浩后面一起跑起来。

下课铃声响了，霍雨浩躺倒在地上，眼前一阵发黑。

这时，他的视线里忽然出现了一张美丽的脸。

“王冬。”

霍雨浩想要坐起来，但没有这个力气了。

他就这样躺着看着王冬儿，傻傻地笑。

“真是个笨蛋，跑不动了就不跑了嘛。”

“我想要看看，自己能坚持多久。”

霍雨浩很庆幸自己坚持下来。

“你来这里做什么？”

周漪忽然走过来询问。

王冬儿看着周漪，说道：“我还没有收到学院的开除通知，自然还算是史莱克的学生。”

周漪看了霍雨浩一眼，欣慰的点点头，随后就走开了。

周漪请来了一位魂圣级别的治疗系魂师，为学生们进行治疗。

霍雨浩感觉自己的疲惫一下子就消失了。

Page (1/3)

When he came back from get out of class at noon, Huo Yuhao recounted to Wang Donger the content of Zhou Yi's lecture in the morning, worried that she had missed important knowledge.

Of course Wang Donger knew all these contents, but she did not stop Huo Yuhao and listened to him with relish.

"Is there anything else, Teacher Huo?"

Huo Yuhao blushed when Wang Donger called him Teacher Huo.

"That's all we talked about in class."

"By the way, Teacher Zhou took me to the soul guidance device research institute after class. I will learn how to make soul guidance devices in the future."

"Wouldn't this be too tiring?"

Huo Yuhao shook his head: "No, I also want to learn more and become stronger."

"Come on, I think you will definitely become a very strong soul master and soul mentor in the future." Wang Dong'er encouraged Huo Yuhao.

"Really?"

"Of course, I believe you will be fine."

Huo Yuhao was very happy to gain Wang Donger's trust.

In the afternoon, Wang Donger did not go to class with Huo Yuhao.

But she still came to the playground where the class was held and watched Huo Yuhao running with heavy weights.

After running in the morning and running in the afternoon, does Zhou Yi have nothing else to teach?

Wang Donger's eyes kept falling on Huo Yuhao.

Seeing that little body carrying the weight, she felt very distressed.

He was so strong, even though he was the one with the weakest soul power, he still persisted until the end.

The other students who had given up were moved when they saw Huo Yuhao's perseverance and started running after Huo Yuhao.

The bell rang for the end of get out of class, and Huo Yuhao lay on the ground, his eyes darkening for a while.

At this time, a beautiful face suddenly appeared in his sight.

"Wang Dong."

Huo Yuhao wanted to sit up, but he didn't have the strength.

He just lay there and looked at Wang Dong'er, smiling stupidly.

"What an idiot. Why don't you just run away if you can't run anymore?"

"I want to see how long I can last."

Huo Yuhao was very glad that he persevered.

"What are you doing here?"

Zhou Yi suddenly came over and asked.

Wang Donger looked at Zhou Yi and said, "I haven't received the expulsion notice from the college, so naturally I am still a student of Shrek."

Zhou Yi glanced at Huo Yuhao, nodded happily, and then walked away.

Zhou Yi invited a soul saint-level healing soul master to treat the students.

Huo Yuhao felt that his fatigue disappeared all of a sudden.
